name: Luxembourg

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, transversal pass over the population indicator. Population on 1 January 2025: 681973 inhabitants, recorded as 0.682 million. Eurostat dataset demo_pjan, Population on 1 January by age and sex, read through the dissemination API on 2026-07-27, dataset last updated 2026-07-09. Total population, both sexes, all ages, which is exactly what this indicator's denominator asks for. Read as one table covering every country in the record, so no value here is derived from a neighbour: each is that country's own row. The previous value was an opening estimate produced with no source and no research.

Collected on 2026-07-28, in French and German, reopening the pass that stalled here on 2026-07-27. One unit, one house, where the opening estimate was 0.5 and where the previous session produced nothing. The stop on 27 July was correct in method and wrong in fact, and the reason is worth keeping: every search in French and German returned the Théâtre des marionnettes du jardin du Luxembourg, which is in Paris and belongs to the French Senate, and the noise of that one Parisian park buried the Grand Duchy entirely. What found the house was searching in the language of the thing rather than the name of the country — Figurentheater, Puppentheater, Marionettentheater — which surfaced the German Wikipedia list of standing figure theatres, whose criterion is exactly this indicator's: permanent stages, touring companies excluded. It carries one Luxembourgish entry. Poppespënnchen is a marionette theatre at 1, place Saintignon in Lasauvage, a village of the commune of Differdange, and it says on every page of its own site that it works with the financial support of the Ministry of Culture of the Grand Duchy and of the Ville de Differdange. It has existed since 2015 and was founded by the puppeteers Pit Vinandy, of the Bimbotheater and the Poppentheater Hoplabum, by Michael and Andrey Schneider of the Theater Favoletta, and by Georges Liesch. Its own account of itself is the denominator almost word for word: to offer families and adults a place where they can regularly enjoy the art, and from the beginning to present not only their own stages but other companies too, so that the diversity of the form can be seen. That last sentence would have made it a strand under the old wording and makes it a house under the new one, decided on 2026-07-28: a house that programmes and takes responsibility for the work is a venue whether or not it holds a company of its own. It also runs the Marionnettes Sauvages festival, which invites companies from all of Europe; the festival itself is outside the denominator, the house that holds it is not. The theatre played it again in May 2026, when a Luxembourg daily went to Lasauvage and found Pit Vinandy running the place and the festival deliberately built against the idea that puppetry is for children only. Two things keep the record disputed. The theatre's own season page carried no programme when read, and its ticketing link showed no dates, which in late July is what a small house looks like out of season but is not proof of a season; and the count rests on one venue whose only readable backing is a line the venue writes about itself, no ministerial award having been opened. Everything else in the country was read and is empty. The Theater Federatioun, the federation of the profession since 1996, lists twenty-three members — the municipal theatres of Esch and the capital, the TOL, the TNL, the Centaure, the Kasemattentheater, the regional cultural centres, Rotondes, Neimënster, the independent companies — and not one is a puppet, figure or object theatre. Its own nineteen-page panorama of the performing arts in Luxembourg, published in 2022, does not contain the word marionnette once. The doubt in this country runs downward, not upward: if Poppespënnchen has stopped playing, Luxembourg is a sourced zero.

observations.reasoning: Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. No establishment retained, and Luxembourg is the only country in this pass where the zero rests on an argument from exhaustiveness rather than on an absence of results. The Luxembourg state's official guidance portal states that no higher education course in dramatic art is offered in Luxembourg: the Conservatoire de Luxembourg alone teaches drama and diction, but its qualifications do not belong to higher education and serve as preparation for schools abroad. If no higher training in dramatic art exists in the country, then a fortiori no specialised higher training in puppetry arts can exist. Upper bound held at 0 for that reason, rather than raised to 1 as in the other countries without a candidate. Confidence kept at estimate despite the strength of the argument: the portal refused automated reading and the statement is known only through a search summary.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
